stories.title: Hong Kong crowds brave the heat to secure spots for National Day fireworks

en.title: Hong Kong crowds brave the heat to secure spots for National Day fireworks
en.summary: Large crowds of residents and tourists gathered along Victoria Harbour ahead of Hong Kong's National Day fireworks display, arriving hours early despite intense heat to secure prime viewing locations. Authorities anticipated approximately 260,000 attendees for the 23-minute event.

stories.title: Elon Musk returns to US government for Pentagon war study

en.title: Elon Musk returns to US government for Pentagon war study
en.summary: Tech entrepreneur Elon Musk will co-lead a Pentagon initiative called Project Meridian to study the future of warfare under the Trump administration. Musk previously served as head of the Department of Government Efficiency before departing in May.

stories.title: Days after Xi-Trump summit, the US marks China’s National Day with pared-down note

en.title: Days after Xi-Trump summit, the US marks China's National Day with pared-down note
en.summary: The US State Department issued a brief greeting for China's National Day anniversary without mentioning President Xi's recent Washington visit or any trade agreements reached during their meeting. The statement contained minimal ceremonial acknowledgment.

stories.title: Chinese hair embroidery uses human hair instead of silk thread to create ultra-fine portraits

en.title: Chinese hair embroidery uses human hair instead of silk thread to create ultra-fine portraits
en.summary: Hair embroidery, a traditional Chinese art form originating in Jiangsu province over 1,000 years ago, uses human hair to create intricate portraits. Individual pieces can require skilled artisans several months to years to complete.

stories.title: National Day: Hongkongers visit Shenzhen for shopping and 60cm egg tarts

en.title: National Day: Hongkongers visit Shenzhen for shopping and 60cm egg tarts
en.summary: During National Day, thousands of Hong Kong residents crossed into Shenzhen for shopping, massages, and leisure activities, attracted by lower prices and wider variety. About 69,000 residents left Hong Kong by mid-morning while approximately 74,000 mainland visitors entered the city.

stories.title: Indonesia’s Prabowo appoints new foreign minister

en.title: Indonesia's Prabowo appoints new foreign minister
en.summary: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto replaced his foreign minister with a career diplomat and former UN representative in a cabinet reshuffle. The outgoing foreign minister was reassigned to lead the Human Development ministry.

stories.title: Indonesia’s Prabowo appoints new police chief following scandals at the force

en.title: Indonesia's Prabowo appoints new police chief following scandals at the force
en.summary: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto dismissed the national police chief and appointed the head of the National Narcotics Agency to replace him. The change follows reports of police misconduct during the previous chief's tenure.

stories.title: 鏖战抽筋、老将坚守、对手互敬……亚运会上，那些超越胜负的动人场面

en.title: Intense competition, veteran perseverance, mutual respect among opponents: memorable moments at Asian Games that transcend winning and losing
en.summary: Halfway through the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, medal competitions continue to captivate audiences. The appeal of competitive sports extends beyond the highlight moments of standing on the podium.

stories.title: 2026长沙芒果国际车展开幕 激活国庆汽车消费市场

en.title: 2026 Changsha Mango International Auto Show Opens, Activates National Day Auto Consumer Market
en.summary: The 2026 Changsha Mango International Auto Show opened on October 1st in Hunan, featuring approximately 30,000 square meters of exhibition space with luxury, joint venture, domestic, and new energy vehicle models. The event is projected to attract over 100,000 visitors and generate sales exceeding 1.5 billion yuan.

stories.title: Hong Kong needs new funding model to draw investment from global drug makers: AstraZeneca

en.title: Hong Kong needs new funding model to draw investment from global drug makers: AstraZeneca
en.summary: AstraZeneca states that Hong Kong can attract greater biotech investment by establishing a new healthcare financial model. The company has conducted over 60 clinical trials and invested more than HK$200 million in Hong Kong over the past three years despite increased global pharmaceutical investment in mainland China.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s 5-year plan underlines ‘DNA’ as a global city, market economy: John Lee

en.title: Hong Kong's 5-year plan underlines 'DNA' as a global city, market economy: John Lee
en.summary: Chief Executive John Lee described Hong Kong's inaugural five-year plan as reinforcing the city's identity as an international market economy amid geopolitical changes and artificial intelligence growth. The plan provides strategic vision while maintaining the city's core characteristics.

stories.title: Hong Kong rises to 14th in Global Innovation Index

en.title: Hong Kong rises to 14th in Global Innovation Index
en.summary: Hong Kong climbed one position to rank 14th among 139 economies in the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization, while maintaining its fifth place position in Asia.

stories.title: China’s carmakers eye record 12 million overseas sales in 2026 as ‘go global’ plan pays off

en.title: China's carmakers eye record 12 million overseas sales in 2026 as 'go global' plan pays off
en.summary: Chinese automakers including BYD and Chery are expanding internationally and expect to achieve record overseas sales of 12 million vehicles in 2026. The companies have become competitive in markets previously dominated by Western manufacturers like Volkswagen, benefiting from geopolitical factors and rising global demand for alternatives.

stories.title: ‘China’s Warren Buffett’ adds Moutai shares for 3rd time as baijiu sector seeks bottom

en.title: 'China's Warren Buffett' adds Moutai shares for 3rd time as baijiu sector seeks bottom
en.summary: Chinese-American billionaire investor Duan Yongping purchased 30,000 additional shares of baijiu maker Kweichou Moutai, marking his third stake increase this year as the sector experiences a downturn. The baijiu industry faces reduced demand due to stricter oversight and anti-corruption measures affecting corporate gifting practices.

stories.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies

en.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies
en.summary: Hong Kong banks are offering incentives to attract mainland Chinese visitors during golden week, including cash bonuses and entertainment experiences, following Beijing's new 20 percent levy on overseas investment and insurance gains.

stories.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination

en.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination
en.summary: New World Development reported a HK$26.8 billion net loss for the year ended June, primarily due to HK$18.3 billion in impairments related to the early termination of its 11 Skies mall project.
